forbidden.title: The team is managed by your admins
forbidden.body: Only owners, admins and managers can see the member list. Ask one of them if you need a change.

empty.alone: You're the only one here. Invite the people who'll carry cards and chips.

OWNER.name: Owner
OWNER.summary: Everything, including billing, ownership and deleting the workspace.

ADMIN.name: Admin
ADMIN.summary: Runs the workspace: people, teams, branding, billing and the activity log.

MANAGER.name: Manager
MANAGER.summary: Sees the team and handles NFC chips, without changing people or settings.

EMPLOYEE.name: Member
EMPLOYEE.summary: Works on their own cards, chips and leads.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: They lose access to this workspace right away. Their cards and leads stay with the workspace.

details.invitedNote: They haven't answered the invitation yet. They join once they accept it, from the email or from the app if they already have an account.
details.suspendedNote: They can't sign in to this workspace until access is restored.
details.selfNote: This is you. Another owner or admin changes your role.

import.title: Import people
import.subtitle: Invite a whole team from an Excel or CSV file.
import.pick: Choose an Excel or CSV file
import.pickHint: Or drop it here. Up to {{max}} people at a time.

columns.others: Name, Job title, Phone and Team are used when they're there. Teams that don't exist yet are created.
columns.role: Role can be Admin, Manager or Employee; anyone without one joins as an Employee.

import.tooMany: Only the first {{max}} rows are shown. Import the rest in another file.
import.createCards: Create a card for each person
import.createCardsHint: Filled in with their name, title, company, phone and email, ready for them to add a photo and publish.

done.title: Import finished
done.next: Each person gets an email to join. Their cards are drafts until they publish them.
done.emailFailed: Invited, but the email didn't send. Resend it from their profile.

errors.noEmail: No Email column found. Add a column headed "Email" and try again.
errors.empty: There's no one in this file.
errors.read: This file couldn't be read. Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
errors.send: The import didn't go through. Try again.

import.planFull: Your plan has no room for more people, so no one here will be invited.
import.planRoom_one: Your plan has room for one more person; the rest won't be invited.
import.planRoom_other: Your plan has room for {{value}} more people; the rest won't be invited.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.subtitle: They get an email to join this workspace, and join only if they accept.
invite.name: Name
invite.emailFailed: {{email}} was added, but the email didn't go out. Try inviting them again later.

personal.title: This is your personal workspace
personal.body: To invite people and make teams, make it a company or team workspace. Your cards, leads and chips stay as they are.

teams.emptyBody: Group people into teams, and teams into departments, to see who brings clients in.
teams.deptEmpty: No teams in this department yet.
teams.name: Name
teams.statsNote: Counted across the cards of everyone in the team, all time.
teams.noMembers: Nobody is in this team yet.
teams.moveNote: Someone already in another team moves to this one.
teams.deleteTeamBody: Its people stay in the workspace without a team.
teams.deleteDeptBody: Its teams stay, without a department.

rolesView.note: These are the built-in roles, enforced by the server. Make your own below.

viewMembers.label: See members
viewMembers.desc: The member list and each person's details

changeRoles.label: Change roles and access
changeRoles.desc: Change a role, suspend or restore access

remove.label: Remove people
remove.desc: Take away access to the workspace

manageTeams.label: Manage teams
manageTeams.desc: Create, rename and delete teams and departments

chips.label: Manage NFC chips
chips.desc: Add chips, link them, hand them out

ownLeads.label: Their own leads
ownLeads.desc: Work the leads their cards bring in

actions.card_moved_in: moved a card into this workspace
actions.card_moved_out: moved a card to another workspace
actions.sso_settings_changed: changed who single sign-on applies to

customRoles.title: Your workspace’s roles
customRoles.intro: Make roles that fit how your company works: start from a built-in role, which decides what data people see (every lead, or their own), then choose what they can change in each part of the workspace.
customRoles.sheetHint: People with this role get exactly what you choose here, nothing more.
customRoles.empty: No roles of your own yet.
customRoles.emptyEdit: No roles of your own yet. Make one for a job the built-in roles don’t fit, like someone who handles billing only.
customRoles.confirmDelete_one: Delete “{{name}}”? The person holding it keeps its base role.
customRoles.confirmDelete_other: Delete “{{name}}”? The {{count}} people holding it keep its base role.
customRoles.ownWorkOnly: Their own cards and leads only
customRoles.name: Name
customRoles.namePlaceholder: e.g. Billing, Event staff, Sales lead
customRoles.baseHint: Decides what data they see: admins and managers see every lead and card; employees their own. Choosing one fills in its permissions, which you can then change.
customRoles.noAccess: No access beyond their own work.
customRoles.never: Changing roles and access, transferring ownership and deleting the workspace stay with built-in owners and admins.

people.full: See members, invite people and remove them.

integrations.full: Also connect apps, and manage automations, webhooks and API keys.

billing.name: Billing
